correctness.rationale: Lifting a crown self-map to the infinite fence gives increments in \(\{-1,0,1\}\), so the degree lies in \(\{-1,0,1\}\). Degree \(\pm1\) forces equality in the variation bound, hence every increment has the same sign and the map is one of the \(2n\) order automorphisms. Degree zero admits a closed lift; if its image met every crown point, the lift range would have width at least \(2n-1\), forcing total variation at least \(4n-2\), impossible for \(2n\) unit-bounded steps. Thus the image omits a point and factors through a finite fence, which is contractible by beat-point deletion. Minimality of the crown makes distinct automorphisms nonhomotopic. The bundled verifier independently confirms the stated map counts and homotopy components through \(n=4\).
